risks.title: Unencrypted Patient Data at Rest
risks.description: Patient health records stored in PostgreSQL do not appear to use column-level or disk-level encryption.
risks.evidence: No encryption layer present between Billing/Appointment services and PostgreSQL in the diagram.
risks.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest (e.g. TDE or disk encryption) and encrypt sensitive PII/PHI columns.

risks.title: Single Point of Failure in API Gateway
risks.description: A single API Gateway instance handles all traffic from both patient and doctor clients.
risks.evidence: Only one API Gateway node shown in the architecture diagram with no redundancy.
risks.recommendation: Deploy multiple API Gateway replicas behind a load balancer with health checks.

risks.title: Unbounded Message Queue Growth
risks.description: IoT Device Gateway publishes to RabbitMQ without visible backpressure or dead-letter handling.
risks.evidence: No dead-letter queue or consumer scaling policy indicated.
risks.recommendation: Add dead-letter queues, consumer auto-scaling, and message TTLs to prevent unbounded growth.

risks.title: No Cost Controls on IoT Ingestion
risks.description: High-frequency IoT device data ingestion could cause unpredictable infrastructure costs at scale.
risks.evidence: IoT Device Gateway connects directly to the message queue with no rate limiting or batching visible.
risks.recommendation: Implement request batching, sampling, or tiered ingestion pricing alerts to control costs.

risks.title: Payment Service Directly Reachable Without Isolation
risks.description: The Payment Service communicates with a third-party payment provider without an indicated network segmentation boundary.
risks.evidence: Payment Service is on the same network tier as Order Service with no firewall/VPC boundary shown.
risks.recommendation: Isolate the Payment Service in a dedicated PCI-DSS-compliant network segment with strict egress rules.

risks.title: Cache Invalidation Risk on Cart Service
risks.description: Cart Service relies on Redis Cache without a clear invalidation or persistence strategy shown.
risks.evidence: Cart Service -> Redis Cache route has no corresponding database write path in the diagram.
risks.recommendation: Add a write-through or write-behind strategy so cart data survives cache eviction/restarts.

risks.title: Elasticsearch Cluster Cost Growth
risks.description: Product Catalog Service depends on Elasticsearch, which can become costly at scale if not right-sized.
risks.evidence: No indication of index lifecycle management or node auto-scaling policies.
risks.recommendation: Set up index lifecycle management (ILM) and monitor node utilization to right-size the cluster.

risks.title: No Rate Limiting on Public API Gateway
risks.description: The API Gateway accepts traffic from both the web frontend and mobile app with no visible rate limiting.
risks.evidence: Both Web Frontend and Mobile App connect directly to the API Gateway with a single unguarded entry point.
risks.recommendation: Apply per-client rate limiting and WAF rules at the API Gateway layer.

risks.title: Single FastAPI Backend Instance
risks.description: All three portals (student, faculty, admin) route through what appears to be a single FastAPI backend with no redundancy.
risks.evidence: Only one 'FastAPI Backend' node is present in the architecture diagram.
risks.recommendation: Run multiple backend instances behind a load balancer, and add readiness/liveness probes.

risks.title: Admin Dashboard Shares Same Backend as Student Portal
risks.description: The Admin Dashboard uses the same FastAPI Backend and routes as the student-facing portal without a clear privilege boundary.
risks.evidence: Admin Dashboard -> FastAPI Backend uses the same route as Student Portal -> FastAPI Backend.
risks.recommendation: Separate admin routes with stricter authentication (MFA) and role-based access control.

risks.title: Unmanaged File Storage Growth
risks.description: File Storage for student/faculty uploads has no visible lifecycle or archival policy.
risks.evidence: FastAPI Backend -> File Storage route has no accompanying retention policy documentation.
risks.recommendation: Add storage lifecycle rules (e.g. move old files to cold storage) to control long-term costs.
